parsed.degree_signal: abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Ingenieurinformatik, Data Science oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
parsed.notes:
“Be our forward thinker” is the qualifications section; no optional heading or inline optional markers appear.
Skills appearing only under “Make it happen” are excluded. Data Science names a degree field, not a separate skill requirement.
Containerisierung und Orchestrierung refers literally to containers in the Docker/Kubernetes context, not LLM orchestration.
Generative-AI and LLM collapse into the same taxonomy skill; the quote preserves their coordinated wording.
“fundierte Erfahrung” gives neither years nor an explicit proven-experience or leadership signal, so seniority is null.
The unspecified completed degree maps to bachelor; a comparable field does not allow experience instead of the degree.
